eur.head: Euro Battles at 1.1000 as Dollar Rally Tests Support
eur.plain: The euro is under pressure near the 1.1000 level as recent US dollar gains push prices toward 1.0960. How price behaves around this support area will be crucial as traders brace for upcoming central bank commentary.
pts: Dollar Strength
Persistent US dollar buying has pressured EURUSD lower toward 1.0960 and out of its rising channel.
1.1000 Pivot
The 1.1000 handle remains in the spotlight as the market debates whether the dollar rally has lost steam.
Heavy Central Bank Slate
Speeches from Fed Chairman Warsh and ECB President Lagarde, alongside FOMC minutes, could decide the next directional push.

gbp.head: GBP/USD Tests Key Levels Amid Competing Rate Bets
gbp.plain: GBP/USD is treading cautiously around 1.3200 after snapping a five-day losing streak fueled by rising Bank of England rate hike expectations. However, recent downside pressure from surging Fed hike bets continues to keep the pair's broader yearly range on the line.
pts: Pressure on Yearly Range
Surging Fed hike bets pushed the pair down to 1.3180, threatening its yearly range after a steep plunge.
Losing Streak Broken
The pound found some relief to halt a five-day slide as traders priced in growing bets of a Bank of England rate increase.
Crucial Data Ahead
Markets remain hesitant near 1.3200 while awaiting high-impact UK CPI figures and multiple appearances from BOE Governor Bailey.

gbp.plan: Stay alert around the 1.3200 zone and avoid chasing moves ahead of pivotal central bank remarks and inflation prints.

jpy.head: USD/JPY Tests 160 as Breakout Reaches 10-Week Highs
jpy.plain: USD/JPY is pressing toward the major 160.00 level after reaching fresh 10-week highs, underpinned by ongoing central bank divergence. This matters because traders are closely watching whether this push above key support near the 200-day SMA at 158.80 is a real breakout or a fake out.
pts: Key Levels in Play
The pair has hit 10-week highs testing 160.00, with technical support seen around the 200-day SMA near 158.80.
Divergence & Long-Term Targets
Central bank divergence continues to drive two-way risk, while Morgan Stanley sees fair value above 170 and forecasts the pair at 162 by late 2027.
Fed Commentary on Deck
Traders face key catalysts this week, beginning with a speech from Fed Chairman Warsh alongside high-impact US Retail Sales and FOMC Meeting Minutes.
jpy.watch: Fed Chairman Warsh's speech and the upcoming US Retail Sales release
jpy.plan: Keep a close eye on the 160.00 test and exercise patience to see if the breakout holds before committing to new positions.
